PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?cap ?label WHERE {
  ?org sdk:hasProcessCapability ?cap .
  ?cap rdfs:label ?label .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?label)), "machining"))
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX bfo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/>

SELECT ?zipCode WHERE {
  ?site a sdk:GeospatialLocation ;
        sdk:hasPostalAddress ?addr ;
        sdk:hasZIPcode ?zip .
  ?addr iof-scro:hasTextValue ?addrText .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?addrText)), "suite"))
  ?zip sdk:hasIntegerValue ?zipCode .
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?site ?latitude WHERE {
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city rdfs:label ?cityLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?cityLabel)), "springfield"))
  ?site sdk:hasSpatialCoordinates ?coords .
  ?coords sdk:hasLatitudeValue ?latitude .
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX bfo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?org ?orgLabel ?site ?city ?cityLabel WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       rdfs:label ?orgLabel ;
       sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city rdfs:label ?cityLabel .
  FILTER(regex(?orgLabel, "Robotics", "i"))
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?zipValue WHERE {
  ?company rdfs:label ?label .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?label)), "casting")) .
  ?company sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?loc .
  ?loc sdk:hasZIPcode ?zip .
  ?zip sdk:hasIntegerValue ?zipValue .
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?state ?stateLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?org) AS ?manufacturerCount)
WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?manufacturerCount)

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?city ?cityLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?man) AS ?manufacturerCount)
WHERE {
  ?man a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city rdfs:label ?cityLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?city ?cityLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?manufacturerCount)

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?state ?stateLabel (AVG(?num) AS ?averageNumberOfEmployees)
WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site ;
       sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?numStr .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
  BIND(xsd:decimal(REPLACE(STR(?numStr), ",", "")) AS ?num)
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY ?stateLabel

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?stateLabel (SUM(xsd:integer(REPLACE(str(?emp), ",", ""))) AS ?totalEmployees)
WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?emp ;
       sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY ?stateLabel

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?certificateType (COUNT(DISTINCT ?manufacturer) AS ?manufacturerCount)
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:hasCertificate ?certificateInstance .
  ?certificateInstance a ?certificateType .
}
GROUP BY ?certificateType
ORDER BY DESC(?manufacturerCount)

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

ASK WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?stateLabel)), "texas"))
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?manufacturer ?label ?lon WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?label . }
  ?manufacturer sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:hasSpatialCoordinates ?coords .
  ?coords sdk:hasLongitudeValue ?lon .
  FILTER(xsd:double(?lon) < 100.0)
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?manufacturer ?label ?numEmployees WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                rdfs:label ?label ;
                sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?numStr ;
                sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?stateLabel)), "ohio"))
  BIND(xsd:integer(REPLACE(STR(?numStr), ",", "")) AS ?numEmployees)
}
ORDER BY ASC(?numEmployees)
LIMIT 1

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>

SELECT ?state ?stateLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?man) AS ?numManufacturers)
WHERE {
  ?man a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state a sdk:State .
  OPTIONAL { ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel. }
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?numManufacturers)
LIMIT 1

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel ?latitude
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel ;
                sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:hasSpatialCoordinates ?coords .
  ?coords sdk:hasLatitudeValue ?latitude .
}
ORDER BY DESC(xsd:double(?latitude))
LIMIT 1

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>

SELECT ?manufacturer (COALESCE(?descText, ?name) AS ?displayName)
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?name .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?manufacturer iof-core:describedBy ?descNode .
    ?descNode iof-scro:hasTextValue ?descText .
  }
}
ORDER BY ?descText ?name

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel ?site ?city ?state ?stateLabel
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel ;
                sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(?stateLabel, "California"))
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>

SELECT ?state ?stateLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?manufacturer) AS ?manufacturerCount)
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  OPTIONAL { ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel. }
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?manufacturerCount)

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?state ?stateLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?manufacturer) AS ?numManufacturers)
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?manufacturer sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  OPTIONAL { ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel. }
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?numManufacturers)
LIMIT 1

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?stateLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?org) AS ?manufacturerCount)
WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
  FILTER(
    CONTAINS(LCASE(?stateLabel), "texas") ||
    CONTAINS(LCASE(?stateLabel), "new york") ||
    CONTAINS(LCASE(?stateLabel), "florida")
  )
}
GROUP BY ?stateLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?manufacturerCount)

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?bucket (COUNT(DISTINCT ?company) AS ?companyCount)
WHERE {
  ?company a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
           sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?numStr .
  BIND(xsd:integer(REPLACE(str(?numStr), ",", "")) AS ?employees)
  BIND(
    IF(?employees <= 50,
       "Small: <=50",
       IF(?employees <= 250,
          "Medium: 51-250",
          "Large: >250"
       )
    ) AS ?bucket
  )
  BIND(
    IF(?employees <= 50, 1, IF(?employees <= 250, 2, 3))
    AS ?rank
  )
}
GROUP BY ?bucket ?rank
ORDER BY ?rank

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?manufacturer) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site ;
                (sdk:hasProcessCapability|sdk:hasMaterialCapability) ?cap .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?stateLabel)), "arizona"))
  ?cap a ?capClass .
  ?capClass rdfs:subClassOf* ?coatingClass .
  ?coatingClass rdfs:label "Coating" .
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?manufacturer) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer rdf:type iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:hasProcessCapability ?cap .
  ?cap rdf:type ?capType .
  ?capType rdfs:subClassOf* sdk:SinglePointCuttingCapability .
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?manufacturer sdk:hasProcessCapability ?cap .
  ?cap a ?capType .
  VALUES ?capType {
    sdk:CastingCapability
    sdk:SandCastingCapability
    sdk:DieCastingCapability
    sdk:GravityCastingCapability
    sdk:PermanentMoldCastingCapability
    sdk:CeramicMoldCastingCapability
    sdk:InvestmentCastingCapability
    sdk:MachiningOfCastingCapability
    sdk:SqueezeCastingCapability
    sdk:HotChamberDieCastingCapability
  }
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel }
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?industry ?industryLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?manufacturer) AS ?numManufacturers)
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:suppliesToIndustry ?industry .
  ?industry rdfs:label ?industryLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?industry ?industryLabel
HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?manufacturer) < 5)
ORDER BY ?numManufacturers

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?org ?orgLabel ?cityLabel ?stateLabel WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  OPTIONAL { ?org rdfs:label ?orgLabel. }
  ?org sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?employeesStr .
  FILTER(xsd:integer(REPLACE(str(?employeesStr), ",", "")) > 500)
  ?org sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city rdfs:label ?cityLabel .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
  FILTER(str(?stateLabel) = "California")
  ?org sdk:hasProcessCapability ?cap .
  ?cap a sdk:AdditiveManufacturingCapability .
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?org ?orgLabel WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?org sdk:hasCertificate ?cert1 .
  ?cert1 a sdk:ISO9001 .
  ?org sdk:hasCertificate ?cert2 .
  ?cert2 a sdk:ISO14001 .
  OPTIONAL { ?org rdfs:label ?orgLabel }
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX bfo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/>

SELECT ?naics ?codeVal ?codeText (COUNT(?man) AS ?numManufacturers)
WHERE {
  ?man a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       sdk:hasPrimaryNAICSClassifier ?naics .
  ?naics sdk:hasNAICSCodeValue ?codeVal .
  OPTIONAL { ?naics sdk:hasNAICSTextValue ?codeText . }
}
GROUP BY ?naics ?codeVal ?codeText
ORDER BY DESC(?numManufacturers)
LIMIT 1

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX bfo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?supplier ?label WHERE {
  ?supplier a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  OPTIONAL { ?supplier rdfs:label ?label . }
  ?supplier sdk:hasCertificate ?cert .
  ?cert a sdk:ISO9001 .
  ?supplier sdk:suppliesToIndustry ?ind1 .
  ?ind1 a sdk:RenewableEnergyIndustry .
  ?supplier sdk:suppliesToIndustry ?ind2 .
  ?ind2 a sdk:UtilitiesIndustry .
  FILTER(?ind1 != ?ind2)
}
